sentences.text: A tall tree stands in the yard.
In autumn the tree drops leaves.
Children are sitting under a tree.
The forest is full of birds.
The forest begins after the village.
An old man leans on a stick.
The child picked up a stick from the ground.
There is a stick by the tent.
At the market fruit is cheap.

sentences.target: ես սերմ եմ գցում հողի մեջ։
sentences.text: I put a seed into the soil.
A small seed will soon sprout.
A leaf has fallen on the ground.
The wind carries a leaf away.
A green leaf is on the tree.
The root is deep in the earth.

sentences.target: ծառը խմում է ջուր արմատ միջոցով։
sentences.text: The tree takes water through the root.
Bark feels rough to the touch.
An ant walks on the bark.
A flower is in the vase.
Grass is soft under the feet.
There is a rope by the boat.

sentences.target: նա պարան է օգտագործում վրանը ամրացնելու համար։
sentences.text: He uses a rope to secure the tent.
Hand skin is dry in winter.
Meat is boiling in the pot.
Meat at the market is fresh.
The dog is gnawing a bone.
There is fat on the meat.
An egg is in the nest.
I boil an egg in the morning.
A horn hangs on the wall.
A fish's tail helps it swim.
A feather has fallen on the ground.
I comb my hair in the morning.
Cover your head with a hat.
He covers an ear with his hand.

sentences.target: նա փակում է աչք քնելուց առաջ։
sentences.text: She closes an eye before sleeping.
The eye gets tired from the screen.
The nose gets cold in winter.
The mouth is open when laughing.
The foot gets tired from walking.
Put the foot into the shoe.
The knee was hurt when falling.
A hand is writing a letter.
Warm your hand by the fire.
The hand is clean after washing.
An injured wing does not move.
The belly is full after dinner.
The doctor talks about the guts.
The neck hurts from sitting long.
Rest your back against the chair.

sentences.target: թռչունը տաքացնում է ձագերին կուրծք տակ։
sentences.text: A bird warms chicks under its breast.

sentences.target: սիրտ ուժեղ է առողջ մարդու մոտ։
sentences.text: The heart is strong in a healthy person.

sentences.target: վազելուց հետո սիրտ արագ է աշխատում։
sentences.text: After running the heart works fast.
The liver is an important organ.

sentences.target: տաք օրերին հաճելի է խմել ջուր։
sentences.text: On hot days it is pleasant to drink water.
The child is learning to drink from a cup.
It is time to eat dinner.

sentences.target: շունը կարող է կծել եթե վախենա։
sentences.text: A dog may bite if it is afraid.
Do not try to bite the hard apple.
The child is learning to bite bread.
The baby begins to suck milk.
It is pleasant to suck ice cream.
Do not start to spit on the floor.
The athlete has to spit water.

sentences.target: հիվանդին ասում են թքել բաժակի մեջ։
sentences.text: They tell the patient to spit into a cup.
At sea it is easy to vomit.
The child began to vomit at night.
The wind begins to blow hard.
The child likes to blow out the candle.
One must blow the dust from the table.
In the mountains it is hard to breathe.

sentences.target: վազելուց հետո պետք է շնչել դանդաղ։
sentences.text: After running one must breathe slowly.
The child begins to laugh loudly.
